description: Which built-in caption styles each fixture set covers. Set 1 is the original catalogue; its fixture files in shared/fixtures/captions stay byte-identical when styles are added, because both apps' suites pin their keys and counts. Every later style joins a new set whose vectors live in that set's own folder (layout cases, preview tiles, goldens and index). check_styles.py requires every style file to be in exactly one set.

sets.note: The Roboto Black set (2026-11-05): Marker, Punch-in, Sing-along, Heavy shadow, Glow, Emoji pop and Minimal.
